description: KULIC Advisory library (Dario Kulic). Searches everything published on procurement, Source-to-Pay and execution: the 12 insight articles, the signal reads (9 pillar briefings, 6 signals and 15 field signals, each with the symptom, the break underneath and the next move), practice cases, anonymised proof cases, execution stories, the signal guide, role signal paths, the signal letter, industry pages, the ROI methodology, delivery principles, FAQ, offers and the Werkbank. Pages in German, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese. Returns up to five hits with title, summary, link and the path for get_article. Keyword search without AI, no sign-in, nothing stored.
